messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty: INC-2026 triggered — inference-gateway-usw2 error-rate (5xx) breached 0.8% -> 3.6% over 2m. Auto-page sent. See runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/inference/5xx-wave

oncall-marc: ack INC-2026 :hand: I'm on it. Initial check: dashboards show spike from 11:32 -> 11:36 UTC.

samira: I can confirm elevated 502s on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings-backend. RUIs show backend pool returning 502s, possibly origin timeouts.

rui: Is this global? I see region-usw2 only. Traffic not routed to fallback yet. Can we shift traffic to fallback region-eu? :thinking: 

oncall-marc: starting fallback routing to eu (weight 80%) — will post update. command: `./ops route shift --from=usw2 --to=euw1 --weight=80`

eng-sre: checking kvcache/proxy logs for errors. quick grep: ```grep -c "502" /var/log/proxy/2026-11-32.log -> 1240``` looks like proxy backend flapping.

samira: customer impact: a dozen customers hitting embeddings ingest see failures. Notifying CS to surface high-volume customers. Adding customer-impact tag to the incident.

ops-bot: Traffic shift initiated. New routing: 80% -> euw1, 20% -> usw2. Latency and error dashboards updating.

oncall-marc: Error rate dropped from 3.6% -> 0.9% in 3 minutes after shift. Keeping monitoring for 15m. Will open PD escalation if it rebounds.

rui: We'll investigate origin pool (k8s HPA and pod restarts). If we need, plan: rollback the latest origin config commit (sha abc123) — any objections?

samira: No objections. I'll look at origin health and pod restarts (kubectl get pods -n origin). posting pod restart snippet: ```kubectl get pods -n origin -o wide --show-labels | grep ready:false```

oncall-marc: :thumbsup: good catch. If stable at 15m, we'll close incident and follow up with postmortem. Adding follow-up owners: samira (investigation), rui (rollback prep), eng-sre (postmortem).

incidentbot: INC-2026 updated: status acknowledged -> mitigated (traffic-shift). Auto-close window starts 15m after stabilization.
